verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Corporations is a government filing service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and filings run through PDF forms, mail, fax and a CAPTCHA-gated web portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
